answer: Deposits are visible in gale, and ivory reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 189 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dawn account. A bond of 57% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The attacker spends 180 dollars and 16 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
